Q48A.note:
Accountability-owner question for elected parliamentarians; the option list assigns ownership to executive, parliament/council, party, voters, or no one, so the observation contrasts who is normatively responsible for post-election performance rather than who in fact monitors. It carries special codes 93 = not asked in Burkina Faso after 4th of October and 94 = not asked in country.
